svg.title: Study a set of selected notebook sources
svg.desc: The same set of notes can support a direct answer or a study activity. Both need a check against the original material. Select notes. Choose the sources you want the notebook to use. Choose an output. Ask a question in chat or use Studio to create a study aid. Verify. Find the line in a source that supports a claim in the answer or activity.
